name: Ceramic braces
lead: Ceramic braces are fixed orthodontic appliances whose brackets are tooth-coloured rather than metal, designed to be less noticeable than traditional metal braces. They work like other fixed braces, using brackets and an archwire to apply pressure that moves teeth [7].

Research includes comparisons of microbial adhesion on metal, ceramic and self-ligating brackets in vitro [2], surveys of how adults weigh aesthetics when choosing appliances [4], and a study of appliance type and hiring prospects [3].

paras: Ceramic and clear aligners are described as cosmetic options compared with traditional metallic braces [3]. Adult patients reportedly want discreet appliances, but the factors shaping their choice are still poorly understood [4].

A cross-sectional study photographed models with metal braces, ceramic braces and clear aligners to examine effects on job-hiring prospects in Saudi Arabia [3]. A 2025 study compared oral-health-related quality of life in adults with ceramic braces versus aligners [8].

Fixed appliances are associated with increased Candida colonisation in a prospective controlled trial [1]. In vitro studies have examined biofilm formation on bracket types [2], salivary pH effects of different appliances [6], and enamel micro-cracks and debonding of ceramic brackets after thermocycling [5].

A prospective controlled trial found fixed orthodontic appliances change oral microbiota including Candida colonisation [1]. A survey study compared quality of life with ceramic braces and aligners [8]. Other findings are laboratory-based [2][5][6].

card.summary: Tooth-coloured fixed braces that trade some visibility for the same bracket-and-wire mechanics.
card.note: Ceramic brackets differ from metal in debonding and enamel-stress laboratory findings.

quick.overview:
Ceramic braces use tooth-coloured brackets with a wire to straighten teeth, aiming to be less visible than metal.

Research is mostly surveys and lab studies.
quick.mechanism: Same as other fixed braces: steady wire pressure moves teeth as bone remodels.
quick.risks: Fixed appliances raise plaque and Candida colonisation; lab work examines enamel micro-cracks on debonding.
